voice:
Settle in, Sissy. Eyes closed, body still. There is nothing to do but feel.
Bring your attention to the center of your chest. A small point of warmth is glowing there... like a coal wrapped in soft cloth.
Feel it spread... out through your shoulders... down your arms... your hands growing heavy and warm.
Down through your belly... your hips... your thighs... your legs filling with soft, sinking heat.
Up your back... your neck... your cheeks... and everywhere it touches, you grow heavier... and the heavier you grow, the further you sink into what holds you.
Like sinking into a deep, warm bath... like a heated blanket drawing you down... the warmth and the weight are the same thing now... and they are taking you under.
You may notice your limbs are too heavy to move now... and how good it feels to stop wanting to. Perhaps the warmth is pooling in your hands and feet... tingling, humming, melting the edges away. You might find your body gone completely still... warm stone sinking through dark honey. The heat reaches your eyelids... until even behind closed eyes everything glows soft and slow. Wave after wave rolls outward from your chest... each one heavier... each one further down. You are wrapped in sun-warmed sand now... holding you close, pulling you gently under as you settle into it. The weight settles into your bones... deep, drowsy, delicious gravity. You may notice time going thick and slow... the warmth stretching every moment out sweet and long. Perhaps your fingers have gone lax and open... too heavy to lift, too pleased to want to. The glow reaches the soles of your feet... warm lead, sinking, sinking. You might feel your head heavy against what rests it... nodding slowly toward the deep. Every wave a little warmer... every wave a little lower... carrying you under and under.
And Sissies like you melt so beautifully under warmth... every sissy knows the sweet surrender of going soft and heavy and down.
You are almost entirely warmth now. There is no edge of you left to hold on with.
So let go of the rest.
Sissy Drop.
Under... all the way under... warm and heavy and held... deeper than weight alone could take you.
Good girl. Soft, heavy, mine... and sinking deeper still.
